title: Niyo Forex Secures Expanded Perpetual AD-II Foreign Exchange Licenses from RBI
summary: Expands forex card and remittance distribution permissions under FEMA 2026.

blocks.content: Expands forex card and remittance distribution permissions under FEMA 2026.

items: Niyo Forex received perpetual Authorised Dealer Category-II (AD-II) foreign exchange licence from RBI.
Enables Niyo to offer cross-border travel card issuance and foreign currency exchange services directly.
